items.title: How much does rebuild time actually depend on what changed?
items.description: Grounded in L3's real numbers: a cold build with a 19.8s dependency install took 24.3s; a source-only rebuild collapsed to 0.6s; a dependency-manifest change brought the full cost back at 21.4s. Drag the expensive layer's cost and flip whether the dependency manifest changed to see why — the source-copy cost barely moves the total either way.

params.name: dependencyLayerSeconds
params.label: Cost of the expensive layer (e.g. npm ci)

params.name: manifestChanged
params.label: Dependency manifest changed? (0 = no, cached / 1 = yes, reruns)

items.compute: const rebuildDependencyLayer = params.manifestChanged >= 0.5; return { totalBuildSeconds: (rebuildDependencyLayer ? params.dependencyLayerSeconds : 0) + params.sourceCopySeconds };
